'''Z1-Z0''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He realized that it is better to lead than to serve.
